verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents remote identity verification via eID or video as part of its notarization flow, which covers the ID-check element of signer verification. There is no evidence of a configurable policy to require stronger verification on specific sensitive documents, and no SMS or knowledge-based options. missing for 10: per-document or policy-level control to require stronger verification, SMS verification, knowledge-based authentication, documentation of how signer identity checks are configured via the API or dashboard, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can require stronger signer identity verification (SMS, ID check, knowledge-based) on sensitive documents

citations.quote: Complete identity verification remotely (eID or video)
businesses can submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows
